title: AI / 工具使用
description: 使用AI工具與數位工具的表達

sentences.en: I asked the AI assistant to help me write an email.
sentences.zh: 我請 AI 助理幫我寫一封電子郵件。

sentences.en: You need to write a clear prompt to get good results.
sentences.zh: 你需要寫一個清楚的提示詞才能得到好結果。

sentences.en: The AI can generate images from text descriptions.
sentences.zh: AI 可以根據文字描述生成圖片。

sentences.en: I automated the report generation process.
sentences.zh: 我自動化了報告產生的流程。

sentences.en: The chatbot answered my question instantly.
sentences.zh: 聊天機器人立刻回答了我的問題。

sentences.en: Machine learning helps the system improve over time.
sentences.zh: 機器學習幫助系統隨時間改善。

sentences.en: I used AI to summarize this long article.
sentences.zh: 我用 AI 來摘要這篇長文章。

sentences.en: The tool can translate text into multiple languages.
sentences.zh: 這個工具可以把文字翻譯成多種語言。

sentences.en: AI-powered search gives more relevant results.
sentences.zh: AI 驅動的搜尋能給出更相關的結果。

sentences.en: I trained a custom model for my project.
sentences.zh: 我為我的專案訓練了一個自訂模型。

sentences.en: The AI detected errors in my code automatically.
sentences.zh: AI 自動偵測到了我程式碼中的錯誤。

sentences.en: You can use voice commands to control the assistant.
sentences.zh: 你可以用語音指令來控制助理。

sentences.en: The recommendation system suggests content based on your history.
sentences.zh: 推薦系統會根據你的歷史紀錄推薦內容。

sentences.en: I set up a workflow to automate repetitive tasks.
sentences.zh: 我設定了一個工作流程來自動化重複性工作。

sentences.en: The AI transcribed the entire meeting recording.
sentences.zh: AI 轉錄了整場會議錄音。

sentences.en: Natural language processing makes chatbots more human-like.
sentences.zh: 自然語言處理讓聊天機器人更像真人。

sentences.en: I asked the AI to proofread my essay.
sentences.zh: 我請 AI 幫我校對我的文章。

sentences.en: The algorithm learns from user behavior.
sentences.zh: 演算法從使用者行為中學習。

sentences.en: AI can help you brainstorm ideas quickly.
sentences.zh: AI 可以幫你快速腦力激盪想法。

sentences.en: I connected the AI tool to my calendar app.
sentences.zh: 我把 AI 工具連接到我的日曆 App。

sentences.en: The smart assistant reminded me of my appointment.
sentences.zh: 智慧助理提醒了我的約會。

sentences.en: I generated a presentation outline using AI.
sentences.zh: 我用 AI 產生了一份簡報大綱。

sentences.en: The model needs more data to improve accuracy.
sentences.zh: 這個模型需要更多資料來提升準確度。

sentences.en: AI-powered grammar tools catch mistakes I miss.
sentences.zh: AI 文法工具能抓到我遺漏的錯誤。

sentences.en: I used a no-code tool to build a simple app.
sentences.zh: 我用無程式碼工具做了一個簡單的 App。

sentences.en: The AI suggested a better way to phrase this sentence.
sentences.zh: AI 建議了更好的方式來表達這個句子。

sentences.en: You can fine-tune the model for specific tasks.
sentences.zh: 你可以針對特定任務微調模型。

sentences.en: The virtual assistant scheduled the meeting for me.
sentences.zh: 虛擬助理幫我安排了會議。

sentences.en: I use text-to-speech to listen to articles.
sentences.zh: 我用文字轉語音來聽文章。

sentences.en: AI is changing the way we work and learn.
sentences.zh: AI 正在改變我們工作和學習的方式。
